audit_status.source_base: Hebrew source via Sefaria with source/English versification reconciliation; public-domain KJV familiar comparison
audit_status.review_note: Drafted a source-grounded English rendering of 2 Chronicles 4 preserving Hebrew material readings, measurements, and name variants; awaits witness-level checks for measurements, metal-terms, and the Huram/Hiram name variant.

verses.restored: Moreover he made an altar of bronze: twenty cubits its length, twenty cubits its breadth, and ten cubits its height.

familiar.text: Moreover he made an altar of brass, twenty cubits the length thereof, and twenty cubits the breadth thereof, and ten cubits the height thereof.

modern.text: He made a bronze altar twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and ten cubits high.

original.text: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח נְחֹ֔שֶׁת עֶשְׂרִ֤ים אַמָּה֙ אָרְכּ֔וֹ וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה רָחְבּ֑וֹ וְעֶ֥שֶׂר אַמּ֖וֹת קוֹמָתֽוֹ

verses.restored: Also he made the molten sea, ten cubits from brim to brim, circular in compass; its height was five cubits, and a line of thirty cubits compassed it round about.

familiar.text: Also he made a molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass, and five cubits the height thereof; and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.

modern.text: He also made the Sea of cast metal. It was circular in shape, measuring ten cubits from rim to rim, five cubits in height, and thirty cubits in circumference.

original.text: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת הַיָּ֖ם מוּצָ֑ק עֶ֣שֶׂר בָּֽ֠אַמָּה מִשְּׂפָת֨וֹ אֶל שְׂפָת֜וֹ עָג֣וֹל סָבִ֗יב וְחָמֵ֤שׁ בָּֽאַמָּה֙ קֽוֹמָת֔וֹ וְקָו֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה יָסֹ֥ב אֹת֖וֹ סָבִֽיב

verses.restored: And under it was the likeness of oxen round about, ten to a cubit, compassing the sea all around; two rows of oxen were cast when it was cast.

familiar.text: And under it was the similitude of oxen, which did compass it round about: ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about. Two rows of oxen were cast, when it was cast.

modern.text: Below the rim, figures of oxen encircled it, ten per cubit all the way around the Sea, cast in two rows as a part of the Sea.

original.text: וּדְמ֣וּת בְּקָרִים֩ תַּ֨חַת ל֜וֹ סָבִ֤יב סָבִיב֙ סוֹבְבִ֣ים אֹת֔וֹ עֶ֚שֶׂר בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה מַקִּיפִ֥ים אֶת הַיָּ֖ם סָבִ֑יב שְׁנַ֤יִם טוּרִים֙ הַבָּקָ֔ר יְצוּקִ֖ים בְּמֻֽצַקְתּֽוֹ

verses.restored: It stood on twelve oxen: three looking toward the north, three toward the west, three toward the south, and three toward the east; the sea was set above them, and all their hind parts were inward.

familiar.text: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.

modern.text: The Sea stood on twelve oxen, three facing north, three facing west, three facing south, and three facing east. The Sea rested on them, with all their hindquarters toward the center.

original.text: עוֹמֵ֞ד עַל שְׁנֵ֧ים עָשָׂ֣ר בָּקָ֗ר שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה פֹנִ֣ים צָפ֡וֹנָה וּשְׁלוֹשָׁה֩ פֹנִ֨ים יָ֜מָּה וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה פֹּנִ֣ים נֶ֗גְבָּה וּשְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פֹּנִ֣ים מִזְרָ֔חָה וְהַיָּ֥ם עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מִלְמָ֑עְלָה וְכָל אֲחֹרֵיהֶ֖ם בָּֽיְתָה

verses.restored: Its thickness was a handbreadth, and its brim like the work of a cup’s rim, with lily-work; it received and held three thousand baths.

familiar.text: And the thickness of it was an handbreadth, and the brim of it like the work of the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies; and it received and held three thousand baths.

notes.title: short
notes.body: ‘Handbreadth’ (Heb. טֶפַח, tefach) and ‘bath’ are preserved as ancient units; volumes require witness calibration.

modern.text: It was a handbreadth thick, and its rim was fashioned like the brim of a cup, like a lily blossom. It could hold three thousand baths. The Ten Basins, Lampstands, and Tables (1 Kings 7:38–39)

original.text: וְעָבְי֣וֹ טֶ֔פַח וּשְׂפָתוֹ֙ כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה שְׂפַת כּ֔וֹס פֶּ֖רַח שֽׁוֹשַׁנָּ֑ה מַחֲזִ֣יק בַּתִּ֔ים שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים יָכִֽיל

verses.restored: He made ten lavers and set five on the right hand and five on the left to wash in them; those who offered the burnt offerings washed in them, but the sea was for the priests to wash in.

familiar.text: He made also ten lavers, and put five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them: such things as they offered for the burnt offering they washed in them; but the sea was for the priests to wash in.

modern.text: He also made ten basins for washing and placed five on the south side and five on the north. The parts of the burnt offering were rinsed in them, but the priests used the Sea for washing.

original.text: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ כִּיּוֹרִים֮ עֲשָׂרָה֒ וַ֠יִּתֵּן חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה מִיָּמִ֜ין וַחֲמִשָּׁ֤ה מִשְּׂמֹאול֙ לְרָחְצָ֣ה בָהֶ֔ם אֶת מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה הָעוֹלָ֖ה יָדִ֣יחוּ בָ֑ם וְהַיָּ֕ם לְרָחְצָ֥ה לַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים בּֽוֹ

verses.restored: And he made ten golden lampstands according to their form, and placed them in the temple, five on the right hand and five on the left.

familiar.text: And he made ten candlesticks of gold according to their form, and set them in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.

modern.text: He made ten gold lampstands according to their specifications and placed them in the temple, five on the south side and five on the north.

original.text: וַ֠יַּעַשׂ אֶת מְנֹר֧וֹת הַזָּהָ֛ב עֶ֖שֶׂר כְּמִשְׁפָּטָ֑ם וַיִּתֵּן֙ בַּֽהֵיכָ֔ל חָמֵ֥שׁ מִיָּמִ֖ין וְחָמֵ֥שׁ מִשְּׂמֹֽאול

verses.restored: He also made ten tables and placed them in the temple, five on the right side and five on the left; and he made a hundred basins of gold.

familiar.text: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. And he made an hundred basons of gold.

modern.text: Additionally, he made ten tables and placed them in the temple, five on the south side and five on the north. He also made a hundred gold bowls. The Courts

original.text: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ שֻׁלְחָנוֹת֮ עֲשָׂרָה֒ וַיַּנַּח֙ בַּֽהֵיכָ֔ל חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה מִיָּמִ֖ין וַחֲמִשָּׁ֣ה מִשְּׂמֹ֑אול וַיַּ֛עַשׂ מִזְרְקֵ֥י זָהָ֖ב מֵאָֽה

verses.restored: Furthermore he made the court of the priests and the great court and doors for the court; he overlaid their doors with bronze.

familiar.text: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, and the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid the doors of them with brass.

modern.text: He made the courtyard of the priests and the large court with its doors, and he overlaid the doors with bronze.

original.text: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ֙ חֲצַ֣ר הַכֹּהֲנִ֔ים וְהָעֲזָרָ֖ה הַגְּדוֹלָ֑ה וּדְלָת֧וֹת לָעֲזָרָ֛ה וְדַלְתוֹתֵיהֶ֖ם צִפָּ֥ה נְחֹֽשֶׁת

verses.restored: And he set the sea on the right side of the east end, beside the south.

familiar.text: And he set the sea on the right side of the east end, over against the south.

modern.text: He put the Sea on the south side, at the southeast corner. Completion of the Bronze Works (1 Kings 7:40–47)

original.text: וְאֶת הַיָּ֗ם נָתַ֞ן מִכֶּ֧תֶף הַיְמָנִ֛ית קֵ֖דְמָה מִמּ֥וּל נֶֽגְבָּה

verses.restored: Huram (also written Hiram in some witnesses) made the pots, the shovels, and the basins; Huram finished the work he was to make for King Solomon for the house of God.

familiar.text: And Huram made the pots, and the shovels, and the basons. And Huram finished the work that he was to make for king Solomon for the house of God;

notes.title: short
notes.body: Name appears with variant forms (חוּרָם / חִירָם); see witness-note for editorial review.

modern.text: Additionally, Huram made the pots, shovels, and sprinkling bowls. So Huram finished the work that he had undertaken for King Solomon in the house of God:

original.text: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ חוּרָ֔ם אֶת הַ֨סִּיר֔וֹת וְאֶת הַיָּעִ֖ים וְאֶת הַמִּזְרָק֑וֹת וַיְכַ֣ל חירם לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֛ה לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה בְּבֵ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים

verses.restored: The two pillars, the pommels, and the chapiters upon the two pillars, and the two wreaths to cover the two pommels that were upon the pillars—these he made.

familiar.text: To wit, the two pillars, and the pommels, and the chapiters which were on the top of the two pillars, and the two wreaths to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were on the top of the pillars;

modern.text: the two pillars; the two bowl-shaped capitals atop the pillars; the two sets of network covering both bowls of the capitals atop the pillars;

original.text: עַמּוּדִ֣ים שְׁנַ֔יִם וְהַגֻּלּ֧וֹת וְהַכֹּתָר֛וֹת עַל רֹ֥אשׁ הָעַמּוּדִ֖ים שְׁתָּ֑יִם וְהַשְּׂבָכ֣וֹת שְׁתַּ֔יִם לְכַסּ֗וֹת אֶת שְׁתֵּי֙ גֻּלּ֣וֹת הַכֹּֽתָר֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל רֹ֥אשׁ הָֽעַמּוּדִֽים

verses.restored: And he made four hundred pomegranates for the two wreaths, two rows of pomegranates for each wreath to cover the two pommels that were upon the pillars.

familiar.text: And four hundred pomegranates on the two wreaths; two rows of pomegranates on each wreath, to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were upon the pillars.

modern.text: the four hundred pomegranates for the two sets of network (two rows of pomegranates for each network covering both the bowl-shaped capitals atop the pillars);

original.text: וְאֶת הָֽרִמּוֹנִ֛ים אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת לִשְׁתֵּ֣י הַשְּׂבָכ֑וֹת שְׁנַ֨יִם טוּרִ֤ים רִמּוֹנִים֙ לַשְּׂבָכָ֣ה הָאֶחָ֔ת לְכַסּ֗וֹת אֶת שְׁתֵּי֙ גֻּלּ֣וֹת הַכֹּֽתָר֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל פְּנֵ֥י הָעַמּוּדִֽים

verses.restored: He made the bases and he made the lavers on the bases.

familiar.text: He made also bases, and lavers made he upon the bases;

modern.text: the stands; the basins on the stands;

original.text: וְאֶת הַמְּכֹנ֖וֹת עָשָׂ֑ה וְאֶת הַכִּיֹּר֥וֹת עָשָׂ֖ה עַל הַמְּכֹנֽוֹת

verses.restored: One sea and twelve oxen under it.

familiar.text: One sea, and twelve oxen under it.

modern.text: the Sea; the twelve oxen underneath the Sea;

original.text: אֶת הַיָּ֖ם אֶחָ֑ד וְאֶת הַבָּקָ֥ר שְׁנֵים עָשָׂ֖ר תַּחְתָּֽיו

verses.restored: Huram's father made the pots, the shovels, the fleshhooks, and all the instruments — Huram’s father made them for King Solomon for the house of YHWH of polished bronze.

familiar.text: The pots also, and the shovels, and the fleshhooks, and all their instruments, did Huram his father make to king Solomon for the house of the LORD of bright brass.

modern.text: and the pots, shovels, meat forks, and all the other articles. All these objects that Huram-abi made for King Solomon for the house of the LORD were of polished bronze.

original.text: וְאֶת הַ֠סִּירוֹת וְאֶת הַיָּעִ֤ים וְאֶת הַמִּזְלָגוֹת֙ וְאֶת כָּל כְּלֵיהֶ֔ם עָשָׂ֞ה חוּרָ֥ם אָבִ֛יו לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לְבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה נְחֹ֖שֶׁת מָרֽוּק

verses.restored: In the plain of the Jordan the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredathah.

familiar.text: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredathah.

modern.text: The king had them cast in clay molds in the plain of the Jordan between Succoth and Zeredah.

original.text: בְּכִכַּ֤ר הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ יְצָקָ֣ם הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ בַּעֲבִ֖י הָאֲדָמָ֑ה בֵּ֥ין סֻכּ֖וֹת וּבֵ֥ין צְרֵדָֽתָה

verses.restored: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance; the weight of the bronze was not searched out.

familiar.text: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance: for the weight of the brass could not be found out.

modern.text: Solomon made all these articles in such great abundance that the weight of the bronze could not be determined. Completion of the Gold Furnishings (1 Kings 7:48–51)

original.text: וַיַּ֧עַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה כָּל הַכֵּלִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה לָרֹ֣ב מְאֹ֑ד כִּ֛י לֹ֥א נֶחְקַ֖ר מִשְׁקַ֥ל הַנְּחֹֽשֶׁת

verses.restored: And Solomon made all the vessels that were for the house of God: the golden altar also, and the tables upon which was the bread of the Presence.

familiar.text: And Solomon made all the vessels that were for the house of God, the golden altar also, and the tables whereon the shewbread was set;

modern.text: Solomon also made all the furnishings for the house of God: the golden altar; the tables on which was placed the Bread of the Presence;

original.text: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אֵ֚ת כָּל הַכֵּלִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְאֵת֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הַזָּהָ֔ב וְאֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָנ֔וֹת וַעֲלֵיהֶ֖ם לֶ֥חֶם הַפָּנִֽים

verses.restored: Also the candlesticks and their lamps to burn in front of the oracle, according to the rule, of pure gold.

familiar.text: Moreover the candlesticks with their lamps, that they should burn after the manner before the oracle, of pure gold;

modern.text: the lampstands of pure gold and their lamps, to burn in front of the inner sanctuary as prescribed;

original.text: וְאֶת הַמְּנֹר֞וֹת וְנֵרֹתֵיהֶ֗ם לְבַעֲרָ֧ם כַּמִּשְׁפָּ֛ט לִפְנֵ֥י הַדְּבִ֖יר זָהָ֥ב סָגֽוּר

verses.restored: And the flowers, the lamps, and the tongs — all of gold; by weight they were of pure gold.

familiar.text: And the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs, made he of gold, and that perfect gold;

modern.text: the flowers, lamps, and tongs of gold—of purest gold;

original.text: וְהַפֶּ֧רַח וְהַנֵּר֛וֹת וְהַמֶּלְקַחַ֖יִם זָהָ֑ב ה֖וּא מִכְל֥וֹת זָהָֽב

verses.restored: And the snuffers, basins, spoons, and censers — all of pure gold; and the entrance of the house, the inner doors for the Most Holy Place, and the doors of the temple, were of gold.

familiar.text: And the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers, of pure gold: and the entry of the house, the inner doors thereof for the most holy place, and the doors of the house of the temple, were of gold.

modern.text: the wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, ladles, and censers of purest gold; and the gold doors of the temple: the inner doors to the Most Holy Place as well as the doors of the main hall.

original.text: וְהַֽמְזַמְּר֧וֹת וְהַמִּזְרָק֛וֹת וְהַכַּפּ֥וֹת וְהַמַּחְתּ֖וֹת זָהָ֣ב סָג֑וּר וּפֶ֣תַח הַ֠בַּיִת דַּלְתוֹתָ֨יו הַפְּנִימִיּ֜וֹת לְקֹ֣דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֗ים וְדַלְתֵ֥י הַבַּ֛יִת לַהֵיכָ֖ל זָהָֽב

translation_notes: Hebrew נְחֹשֶׁת (nechoshet) rendered 'bronze' while noting KJV 'brass'; measurements (cubit, tefach, baths) preserved as ancient units; counting and casting locations follow MT but require comparison with parallel accounts (1 Kings) and Dead Sea/Septuagint witnesses.
Name חוּרָם / חִירָם (Huram/Hiram) flagged as a variant; numerical totals (e.g., 3000 baths, 400 pomegranates) preserved without harmonizing.
safety_note: Technical and ritual details are historic; avoid using these to reproduce consecrated objects or for harmful appropriation.
